e.body: Asia Insurance Review（AIR，`asiainsurancereview.com`）是**亚洲最具影响力的保险行业刊物**，栏目按「市场 / 险种 / 职能」三维切分，可核实结构包括：Magazine（纸质刊物）、News（**Asia / China / China CEO / C-Suite / Non-Life / Life and Health / People / Regional / Regulations / Reinsurance / Risk Management / Technology / Agents / Middle East** / AIR+）、Archives（含 **Conference Dailies** 与 Supplements）、Press Release；另设 **Conferences（会议）**、**Awards（奖项：Asia Industry Awards、Middle East Industry Awards、Trusted Life Agents Awards、Global Insurance Excellence Awards）**、**Calendar 2026**、**eDirectory（行业名录）**。其报道主题也直接反映区域热点（如「寿险正在走向财务规划对话的中心」「亚太可能是全球增长最快的保险区域」「保障需求随风险复杂化而增长」）。对 RIAA：这是**亚洲市场分析的行业口径来源**——与官方监管数据（[[hk-ia-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[japan-fsa-statistics]] 等）互补，官方数据给「市场多大」，行业刊物给「市场在发生什么」；其**年度奖项与会议日历**也是了解区域玩家与建立行业认知的入口，与 [[insuranceasia-news]]（同类亚洲刊物）、[[geneva-association]]（全球智库口径）、[[artemis]]（ILS 专门口径）构成不同粒度的情报层；适合作市场分析作业、行业认知与面试准备。
e.body_en: Asia Insurance Review (AIR, `asiainsurancereview.com`) is **Asia’s most influential insurance industry publication**, structured along three axes — market, line of business and function. Its verifiable structure includes: Magazine (print), News (**Asia / China / China CEO / C-Suite / Non-Life / Life and Health / People / Regional / Regulations / Reinsurance / Risk Management / Technology / Agents / Middle East** / AIR+), Archives (including **Conference Dailies** and supplements) and press releases; it also runs **Conferences**, **Awards** (Asia Industry Awards, Middle East Industry Awards, Trusted Life Agents Awards, Global Insurance Excellence Awards), a **Calendar 2026** and an **eDirectory** of the industry. Its editorial themes mirror regional hot topics (e.g. "life insurance shifting to the centre of the financial planning conversation", "APAC may be the fastest-growing insurance region globally", and protection needs rising as risks become more complex). For RIAA: an **industry-voice source for Asian market analysis** — complementary to official regulatory data ([[hk-ia-statistics]], [[irdai-market-statistics]], [[japan-fsa-statistics]] and others): official data says "how big the market is", the trade press says "what is happening in it"; its **annual awards and conference calendar** are also entry points for knowing the regional players and building industry awareness, and with [[insuranceasia-news]] (a peer Asian title), [[geneva-association]] (global think-tank voice) and [[artemis]] (ILS-specific) it forms intelligence layers at different granularities; suits market-analysis assignments, industry awareness and interview preparation.
